title: testing USB charging cables
creator: pileofstuff
why_selected: Several cable substitutions using one visible test setup
Meter readings and written cable labels can be checked against frames
The creator describes a short cable as disappointing rather than assuming short means good
The creator orders the tested cables from best to worst near the end
pilot: Verify cable identities, test boundaries and stable readings manually before model inference
Ask Meta to observe visible actions and numbers, separating narration from visible readings
Use an early subset to propose a relative-ranking principle
Withhold later spoken evaluations and the final ranking from rule inference and prediction
Predict a later cable comparison after its measurement is visible but before its spoken assessment
Score predicted pairwise preferences in code against the creator's recorded ordering
limitations: This is comparative testing and ranking, not demonstrated keep/repair/reject triage
The custom resistive load is not a constant-current load; do not claim identical current in all tests
Do not invent a pass/fail voltage threshold or claim USB compliance
Cable substitutions, probe handling and unstable readings need manual validation
A few comparisons from one creator are a pilot, not broad generalization evidence
The existing next-action evaluator does not yet implement pairwise ranking evaluation
